user.title: Taylor's 3D
user.description: Stores Taylor's 3D layouts in Home Assistant so every user and device sees the same plan, and loads the card on all dashboards.

select_view.name: Select camera preset
select_view.description: Select a saved view on one open Taylor's 3D card. Specify its panel or card ID, or both. Unavailable or duplicate card targets and unknown presets report an action error.

layout_key.name: Layout key
layout_key.description: The layout_key configured on the intended card.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The saved view ID or its exact, unique name.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: The panel name saved for this browser in the card's Views tab, or automation_panel in its configuration. Provide this or a card ID.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The automation_card_id configured on the card. Provide this or a panel.

mode.name: Camera mode
mode.description: Optional override. Otherwise use the preset's saved mode, or the card's current mode.

return_after.name: Return after
return_after.description: Optional seconds before restoring the previous view and camera. Zero or omitted leaves the selected preset in place. Touching the card or another matching request cancels the return.
